notes.title: Hotfix 1.082 2024-10-24
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198830/0135f5754d2c264122087d4e8dd8ff4c2f0bd569.png

Bug fixes:

 Resolved an issue where spells would be cast when the game was paused. 
 Resolved an issue where torches in some areas would render behind the wall. 
 Fixed an issue where the pause menu would get stuck if opened right before a level-up. 
 Fixed an issue where the fire tome spell at tier 2 couldn't be casted vertically. 
 Resolved an issue where the hertz value in the resolution settings would have multiple decimals. 
 Fixed an issue where players would get stuck between colliders on certain parts of the map. 
 Resolved an issue where players would get stuck between colliders on certain parts of the map. 
 Fixed an issue where the quick-back function of the controller wouldn't work in some menus. 


Improvements / Balance:

 Added a visual prompt for charging enemies and bosses. 
 Changed the multiple auto-attack projectiles to always shot straight, to prevent missing enemies while auto-aiming.
 Changed the charged attack to also "charge down", so the charge doesn't reset if the charge up is canceled before fully charged. 
 Added a visual effect when the player health is below 20%. 
 Added weapon preview and progress visuals for unlocked weapons in the workshop. 
 Added UI for different upgrade materials in the workshop. *
 Changed the layout of the UI-buttons and made descriptions more clear in the research menu to be more intuitive. 
 Changed the event arrows to spawn in the middle of the screen and made them less transparent to make the player more aware of arrows. 
 Made the event arrows dissapear in the menus. 
 Lowered the screenshake effect of the auto-attacks. 
 Changed the description of ingame upgrade descriptions to be more clear. 
 Added an UI-Element to show current mastery level of each weapon in the weapon selection menu.
 Changed the popup description of the healing potion from "Health +20%" to "Heal +20%".


Known issues:

 The game can freeze when pressing the "START"-button in the soundtrack selection menu, currently trying to recreate the issue.

notes.title: 🎉🎮 Controller Support is Here! 🎮🎉
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198830/0135f5754d2c264122087d4e8dd8ff4c2f0bd569.png

🎮 Controller Support is Here! 🎮

I'm excited to announce that Pixelmancy now supports controllers! Whether you're using an Xbox, PlayStation, or other compatible controllers, you can now dive into the game with ease.

What’s new?
  Full controller support throughout the entire game.  Two different aim modes with adjustable sensitivity settings.  Full rebinding of keybindings to customize your controls.  
Thank you for your support - happy gaming! 🎉💜

notes.title: Hotfix 0.6 2024-09-18
